name: Tula Pahate Re
description: Two people from different backgrounds, and different decades. This couple will prove that when two souls are meant to be together, they will find a way to be together.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Isha Practises The Speech Which She Needs To Deliver In Her College. Isha Sees Nimkar Getting Reprimanded By His Boss And Feels Dejected. Myra Rebukes Zende For Giving His Views.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Vikrant's Employees Get Surprised As He Reaches The Office By Helicopter And Then Rides A Cycle To Reach College For An Event. He Shares An Auto With Isha As His Cycle Breaks Down.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Isha Gets Petrified After Seeing Vikrant As The Chief Guest. The Students Mock Her As She Starts Crying. However, Vikrant Defends Her And Offers A Blank Cheque As A Sign Of Trust.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Pushpa Gets Furious At Nimkar For Refusing To Encash The Cheque And Humiliates Him. Isha Takes The Cheque To Return It To Vikrant. Later, Myra Insists Isha Give The Cheque To Her.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Myra Humiliates Isha After Finding An Envelope Empty. Rupali Identifies Vikrant But Doesn't Disclose His Identity To Pushpa At His Request. Isha Tells Nimkar Of The Missing Cheque.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Isha And Nimkar Stop Pushpa From Filling In The Details On The Cheque. Pushpa Says Sorry To Vikrant After Knowing His Identity. Later, Vikrant Invites The Nimkars To His Party.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Pushpa Boasts To Her Neighbours About Going To A Party. Vikrant Tells Isha That He Got Influenced By Her Money-saving Attitude. The Investors Later Get Shocked By His Announcement.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: While Isha Shares Her Ambitions With Vikrant, Nimkar Drapes A Saree In A Drunken State. A Furious Vikrant Rebukes Myra And Holds Her Responsible For The Nimkars' Humiliation.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Myra Seeks Vikrant's Forgiveness Over The Party Incident. Nimkar Helps Isha To Arrange Money For A Party. Later, Myra And Zende Get Shocked To See Isha Taking Vikrant Out With Her.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Vikrant Gets Mesmerised By Isha's Patience, Simplicity And Honesty. Pushpa Gets Worried Over Isha's Whereabouts. Myra And Zende Later Get Disappointed Over Vikrant's Conduct.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Zende Informs Vikrant Of Their Company's Profit. Tillu Criticises Isha And Blames Her For Being Spotted With Vikrant. Shortly, Vikrant Comes And Gives A Befitting Reply To Tillu.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Tillu Informs The Nimkars That Bipin Will Only Marry Isha. Myra Believes That She Has Been Fired, But Vikrant Gives Her A Surprise. Isha's Parents Suggest To Her To Work Smartly.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: Myra Gets Shocked As Zende Informs Her That Isha Has Got A Job In The Organisation. Vikrant Shows Isha Her Desk. The Employees Panic Due To Isha's Mistake, And She Gets Tensed.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: Myra Introduces Isha To Her Colleagues In A Way To Humiliate Her. Vikrant Gets Impressed By Isha's Approach To A Problem. Later, He Orders Zende To Give A Joining Bonus To Isha.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: Vikrant Scolds Isha For Keeping Flowers At The Wrong Place. Isha Forgets The Place They Were Supposed To Go For An Industrial Visit. Vikrant Tries To Analyse The Workers' Problems.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: Vikrant Reprimands The Managers For Behaving Ruthlessly With The Workers. He Apologises To Isha For Speaking Rudely. He Later Questions Myra For Taking Some Wrong Decisions.

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: Bipin Tells Vikrant That He Is Going To Marry Isha. Vikrant Asks Zende To Investigate The Tillus. Isha Finds Vikrant's Behaviour Strange. Myra Asks Isha About Her Marital Status.

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: Myra Feels Jealous After Seeing Vikrant And Isha Eating Food Together. She Tells Zende That Isha Has Become Vikrant's Secretary. A Businessman Wants To Sell His Property To Jaydip.

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: Jaydeep is eager to share the news of Gateway of India with Vikrant. When Jaydeep arrives at Vikrant’s office, Isha stops him from meeting Vikrant as he is in a conference. An offended Jaydeep fires Isha immediately. When Jaydeep informs everyone about the deal, Vikrant realises that it’s a blunder and tries to rectify it. A heartbroken Isha doesn’t share the news of her being fired at home. Rupali suggests Isha look for another job, but the fact that she can’t see Vikrant anymore hurts Isha.

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview: Nimkar’s boss taunts him when he expresses his desire of buying an expensive saree for Isha one day. Vikrant calls Isha’s parents to learn about Isha’s whereabouts. An upset Isha goes to the temple and questions god whether Vikrant feels the same for her. Just then, Vikrant comes to meet Isha at the temple and asks her to rejoin his company the next day since he trusts her. An elated Isha gets sweets for her parents and shares her happiness with Rupali.

videos.title: Episode 21
videos.overview: Isha and her mother argue over Isha wearing an expensive dress to office. At office, Mayra is furious for seeing Isha again. Vikrant gives Isha an opportunity to apologise to Jaydeep. A fuming Jaydeep gives only six minutes to Isha to express herself. Isha explains her innocence by drawing reference to Lord Ganesh’s birth story and apologises to Jaydeep. Eventually, Jaydeep forgives Isha. Later, a grateful Isha asks Vikrant to write something in her slam book.

videos.title: Episode 22
videos.overview: Aware that Vikrant is watching her, Isha pretends she cannot find a rickshaw. Her plan works, and Vikrant offers to drop her home. Isha is delighted and daydreams about Vikrant throughout the drive. Nimkar’s boss arrives home and threatens to sell off the shop if Nimkar does not repay the loan. Nimkar and Pushpa are dumbstruck. Later, their neighbour comes to talk about his son’s and Isha’s wedding. He offers them financial help, but Nimkar refuses. Later, Isha reaches home and praises Vikrant.

videos.title: Episode 23
videos.overview: While Isha shares her feelings for Vikrant with Rupali, Vikrant answers all the questions in Isha’s slam book. Rupali cautions Isha about Vikrant being a middle-aged man and asks her to confirm his marital status. However, Isha feels love doesn’t have any age. After Nimkar and Isha leave for work, Pushpa tells Ranjana her wish to get Isha married to Bipin and plans to convince Nimkar and Isha for the same. Later, Pushpa arrives at Vikrant’s office to invite him for dinner at their place.

videos.title: Episode 24
videos.overview: Pushpa invites Vikrant and Zhende for dinner at her home. Maira gets furious after learning about it and expresses her anger at Zhende, who assures her that her dinner with Vikrant will not be cancelled. Zhende tries to convince Vikrant to go with Maira. Pushpa, Nimkar, and Isha make preparations for the impending dinner. Meanwhile, a man warns Vikrant about his changing fate. Pushpa assures Ranjana about Bipin and Isha's marriage. Isha thanks Vikrant for coming for dinner.

videos.title: Episode 25
videos.overview: Vikrant and Jhende arrive at Isha’s house and Pushpa welcomes them. Before Isha and Nimkar arrive, she pleads with Vikrant to convince them for Isha’s wedding with Bipin. While Nimkar and Vikrant exchange gifts, a ‘Jogtin’, a woman asking for alms, arrives and predicts that Isha’s wedding will take place within a month. The next morning, Pushpa tries to convince Nimkar for Isha and Bipin’s wedding, but he walks off. Later, Rupali reminds Isha to confirm whether Vikrant is married or not.

videos.title: Episode 26
videos.overview: Unsure of Isha’s reaction, Vikrant practises with Jhende on how to convince Isha for her wedding. Just then, Mayra arrives, and on seeing her upset, Vikrant apologises for not turning up for their planned dinner. Later, Jhende informs Mayra about Isha’s wedding, and she rejoices, assuming that Isha will leave her job after her wedding. Mayra reprimands Isha for asking Vikrant’s personal details. After Pushpa’s reminder, Vikrant decides to talk to Isha and calls her to his office.

videos.title: Episode 27
videos.overview: Iisha shares her opinion regarding marriage with Vikrant, and tells him about her expectations from her groom. Jhende interrupts the conversation and informs Vikrant that they need to urgently leave for Karjat. After Vikrant leaves, Iisha finds out from her slam book that Vikrant is unmarried. However, a peon informs Iisha that Vikrant has left due to Mrs Saranjame’s ill-health, which upsets Iisha. At Vikrant’s house, Aaisaheb holds a puja for Vikrant’s wedding, much to Sonya’s irritation.

videos.title: Episode 28
videos.overview: Sonya and Aaisaheb have a war of words when Sonya maligns Vikrant in front of her. Vikrant learns that the news of Aaisaheb’s ill-health was just a ploy. On reaching home, Vikrant seeks Aaisaheb’s blessings before having the cake, which upsets Sonya. Influenced by a fake video, Jaydeep decides to undertake a project of turning copper into gold. Vikrant gifts Aaisaheb the saree that was gifted to him by Nimkar, leaving her surprised. Aaisaheb is hopeful of Vikrant’s marriage.

videos.title: Episode 29
videos.overview: A bank personnel calls and informs Pushpa about a loan offer. Isha shares her confusion regarding Vikrant’s marital status with Rupali, but Rupali asks her to be hopeful. Pushpa calls Vikrant to remind him to convince Isha for the wedding. However, Aaisaheb picks up the call. A curious Aaisaheb questions Jhende about Isha. Puzzled, Jhende tells Vikrant to talk to Isha at the earliest. At midnight, Isha has a nightmare which wakes her. Later, Vikrant calls and asks her to meet him the next day.

videos.title: Episode 30
videos.overview: Tula Pahate Re is a Marathi romantic drama television show starring Subodh Bhave and Gaytri Datar. They belong to different worlds, they are from different backgrounds and two different decades. This couple will prove that when two souls are meant for each other, they will find their way to meet, even if the two belong to two eras!

videos.title: Episode 33
videos.overview: Mr Tillu threatens to cancel the wedding, but Pushpa asks him for a couple of days to convince Nimkar. At home, the Nimkars fail to gather money for a new gas cylinder. Elsewhere, Vikrant prefers normal home food over continental cuisines, which angers Sonya. Nimkar’s boss brutally insults Nimkar when he asks for money. At office, Vikrant calls Isha to his cabin when he learns that she didn’t go for lunch with her colleagues. Isha hesitates to open her lunchbox in front of Vikrant as it’s empty.

videos.title: Episode 36
videos.overview: Isha and Pushpa appease an upset Nimkar. Elsewhere, Aaisaheb makes Vikrant realise again the need to have a partner in life to get rid of his loneliness. Mr Tillu speaks to Nimkar about fixing the wedding date the next day and says he will take care of all the finances. Deciding to share the finances, Isha approaches Mayra for help and asks her to keep it a secret from Vikrant. Mayra gives Isha a cheque worth INR five lakh and puts forth a condition that she should stay away from Vikrant.

videos.title: Episode 37
videos.overview: Isha sets out to encash the cheque given by Mayra and lies to her parents when asked about it. Meanwhile, Vikrant recollects the time spent with Isha. Pushpa informs Vikrant that the wedding date will be fixed today. Later, a casual chat with Jaydeep makes Vikrant realize that one must learn from the past and move on. At Bipin’s house, when Isha and her parents visit to fix the date, Mr. Tillu asks why there aren’t any relatives from their side. Just then, Vikrant walks in, surprising everyone!

videos.title: Episode 38
videos.overview: When the Nimkars and the Tillus meet to fix the wedding date, Vikrant walks in, surprising everyone and making Isha uncomfortable. Vikrant offers to help, but Isha declines it by saying, errands like carrying heavy oil containers are not his cup of tea. Vikrant leaves quietly and reaches home to see Aai Saheb praying for his marriage. He misses Isha but is happy for her. The next day, Vikrant tells Mayra he will be away from office for a week, and lands up at Isha’s house with an oil container!

videos.title: Episode 39
videos.overview: Jhende instructs Vikrant’s bodyguards to stay undercover and watch over him. Mayra overhears his conversation and probes, but Jhende deludes her. Vikrant decides to help the Nimkar family with the wedding preparations. The Nimkars are stunned when Vikrant reveals that, once upon a time, he too lived in a chawl. Isha is confused about Vikrant’s intentions and decides to confront him. She sends her parents off for shopping to get some alone time with Vikrant.

videos.title: Episode 40
videos.overview: Mayra notices Isha’s absence at work and suspects that Vikrant and she are together. Meanwhile, Isha confronts Vikrant about his feelings for her but is left speechless when he plays with words and walks away. Just then, Mr. Tillu walks up to Vikrant with business ideas, which makes Vikrant rethink Isha’s marriage. He then instructs Jhende to verify Mr. Tillu’s background.

videos.title: Episode 41
videos.overview: Jhende obtains information about Mr. Tillu's real motive and relays it to Vikrant. Pushpa and Nimkar are glad to have Vikrant helping them for Isha's wedding, but Isha feels otherwise. The next morning, Vikrant arrives and takes Isha's family, Bipin, and Mr. Tillu out for jogging. Soon, everyone is exhausted except Isha and Vikrant. Isha slips, but Vikrant catches her, much to her delight! In the office, Mayra gets suspicious after learning that Vikrant and Isha haven't arrived yet.

videos.title: Episode 42
videos.overview: Mayra entrusts the responsibility of running the office to Jaydeep. She then calls Isha and reprimands her for taking two days of leave without notice. Isha tells her she needs four days of additional leave for her wedding. Mayra tells Isha to submit her application to Jaydeep. Isha does so, but an ill-mannered Jaydeep tears up her application. Jhende asks Isha about her leave when Mayra informs him about Jaydeep taking over the responsibilities. Further, Jhende warns Mayra against her anger.

videos.title: Episode 43
videos.overview: Jhende informs Vikrant that Jaydeep has rejected Isha’s leave application. Gathering some courage, Isha manages to convince Jaydeep to accept her leave application by narrating the story of ‘Hirkani’. At the jewellery shop, Vikrant and Isha end up liking a ‘mangalsutra’ worth INR 3 lakh. Mr Tillu agrees to buy it in order to save his image. Isha is elated when Vikrant helps her wear the ‘mangalsutra’ while she struggles. Later, Vikrant hides the ‘mangalsutra’ and Mr Tillu insults Isha.

videos.title: Episode 44
videos.overview: While going home, Pushpa gets irritated by a stranger staring at her. Later, Pushpa makes a dish out of leftover rotis and Isha wishes to stitch a dress for herself using Pushpa’s old sarees which impresses Vikrant. While Vikrant and Isha go to fetch the ‘Mangalsutra’, the fellow residents wonder whether Vikrant wants to take over their locality for redevelopment. Further, Isha and Vikrant have a hearty talk. Later, Ranjana and the fellow residents threaten the Nimkars to stay away from Vikrant.

videos.title: Episode 45
videos.overview: Vikrant overhears the fellow residents conversing and reprimands them for threatening Nimkar. He clarifies that he is not eying their locality for redevelopment and urges them to be united. While Vikrant goes to call the Tillus to have a look at the necklaces, he overhears Mr Tillu lamenting about the increased expenses. Mayra calls Vikrant to ask his whereabouts and hears Isha’s voice. Vikrant tries to feed Isha, but she shies away. Mayra smartly makes Jhende reveal Vikrant’s whereabouts.

videos.title: Episode 46
videos.overview: Bipin gets ten gold necklaces for Isha. While the Nimkars worry about the expenses, Isha gets a message on her phone about her first salary being deposited. Pushpa shares her happiness with the neighbouring ladies, but they retort, saying Isha’s salary will be enjoyed by her in-laws. Jhende tells Mayra that Vikrant wants her to make changes in the Employee Manual. When Isha receives a copy of the manual, Vikrant tells her to check with the Tillus whether they approve of all the rules.

videos.title: Episode 47
videos.overview: Isha shows Raghuveer the Employee Manual, and he learns that relatives of an employee are not allowed to associate with Vikrant’s company for business. Furious, he calls off the marriage. Pushpa wants to reason with Raghuveer, but Vikrant volunteers to amend the rule. Raghuveer excitedly agrees to the marriage. However, Pushpa realises the Tillus’ intentions and calls off the wedding. Raghuveer makes threats to seize the Nimkars’ shop. Nimkar’s boss, who was made to tag along, apologises.

videos.title: Episode 48
videos.overview: Pushpa and Mr Nimkar insist Vikrant spend one last day with them, and he obliges. Jhende reminds Vikrant about Jaydeep’s birthday and takes him to the office, where everyone is waiting to cut the cake. Jaydeep introduces everyone to the “money printing machine” that he has bought. He is furious when the machine doesn’t work. Mayra pressurises Jhende to get Vikrant to the office the next day. Isha writes a love letter to Vikrant, and Rupali assures her of Vikrant having similar feelings.

videos.title: Episode 49
videos.overview: Mr Nimkar and Pushpa decide to take Vikrant for lunch to Bollywood Café owing to the discounted prices. In the office, Jhende and Mayra hold Vikrant back for the general body meeting. After a long wait at the restaurant, Isha calls Vikrant, but he doesn’t answer. After Isha’s repeated calls and texts, Vikrant ends the meeting in haste and leaves to go meet the Nimkars. Jhende tries to stop Vikrant from going by emotionally blackmailing him and telling him it is against Peer Baba’s discretion.

videos.title: Episode 50
videos.overview: Vikrant is angry with Jhende for blackmailing him to break the promise he made to the Nimkars. Vikrant explains his state of mind to Jhende by narrating a story. Isha tells Rupali she will wait for Vikrant to approach her. Mr Nimkar is welcomed by his boss to the shop. At office, Mayra asks Isha to make a presentation on Rajnandini sarees. Isha hesitates initially, but, after recalling Vikrant’s words, she suggests recycling sarees into dresses, and everyone is impressed with her proposal.

videos.title: Episode 51
videos.overview: Impressed by Isha’s presentation, the clients tell Vikrant that they want Isha to lead the project. Vikrant apologises to Isha for not turning up for lunch, but she cuts him off saying she has to submit a report to Mayra. Rupali is upset with Ranjana when she insults Isha and Pushpa. Vikrant plans a surprise celebration for Isha’s successful presentation. Mayra is furious as she failed to tarnish Isha’s image. Later, Vikrant asks Isha to write an apology letter to the Nimkars.

videos.title: Episode 52
videos.overview: Bipin, who wants to be friends with Isha, reveals that he knows Vikrant and she are in love with each other. Isha gives Vikrant’s apology letter to Pushpa. In the morning, Bipin gives Isha a ride to office, which Vikrant sees. A fuming Vikrant scolds Isha for being insincere, much to Mayra’s delight. Vikrant calls Isha to his cabin and angrily expresses his feelings. When Isha repeatedly offers him his medicine, he breaks the glass in anger. However, seeing Isha hurt, he tends to her injury.

videos.title: Episode 53
videos.overview: Isha refuses to take an extra lunch box for Vikrant. Mr Nagarkar calls Mayra and tells her he will confirm the meeting only if Isha is available, which irks Mayra. Mayra reprimands Isha for not doing the research about the Raj Nandini sarees. Isha impresses the dealers with her idea of magnifying the demand for Raj Nandini sarees, and asks them to join her in the survey.

videos.title: Episode 54
videos.overview: Jhende asks Vikrant why his behaviour has changed since Isha has come into his life, but Vikrant is unable to answer. The next day, Mayra and Jhende get angry with Vikrant when he questions them about Isha’s whereabouts. Vikrant tells Jhende Isha being a new employee is his responsibility. Pushpa calls Vikrant to ask whether Isha fought with him, but he lies. Later, the dealers and Isha visit Mr Nimkar’s shop for the survey, but Isha refuses to reveal her identity in front of the dealers.

videos.title: Episode 55
videos.overview: The dealers are happy with the survey's outcome. Isha reveals to them that her father works at the shop. Vikrant follows Isha, and during their fight, learns that Vikrant hasn't eaten all day. She takes him to a road-side stall, where Vikrant insists on eating spicy food despite Isha's request. Nimkar informs Pushpa about Isha's visit, and they decide to eat outside. Later, Vikrant is surprised to run into Isha's parents. Isha advises Vikrant to accept the truth to ease his worries.

videos.title: Episode 56
videos.overview: In the car, Vikrant listens to the ‘Love Guru’ radio show, wherein a professor falls in love with his student. Although Vikrant relates to the situation, he hides his feelings from Jhende. During the survey, Mr Shinde badmouths Mayra and Vikrant, and Isha reprimands him. An insulted Mr Shinde complains to Mayra about Isha’s rude behaviour. Vikrant instructs Mayra to take any action she pleases. Later, at office, when Mayra is about to fire Isha, Mr Nagarkar tells the truth and saves Isha.

videos.title: Episode 57
videos.overview: Jhende takes Vikrant to a nostalgic place where they relive their memories. Jhende makes Vikrant realise he is in love with Isha and he is hiding the same from himself. Elsewhere, Bipin gives Isha a red rose and asks her to count its petals to know whether Vikrant will marry her. The ‘Jogtin’ assures Pushpa of Isha’s marriage. Later, Vikrant offers Isha a promotion which requires her to move to Bangalore. Isha tells Vikrant that he cannot stop loving her even if he distances himself from her.

videos.title: Episode 58
videos.overview: Isha gives Vikrant a challenge, wherein they shouldn’t attempt to meet each other in the next 24 hours. However, if they happen to meet each other accidentally, then Vikrant has to accept his feelings for Isha. While Rupali and Bipin plan to make them meet each other, Jhende and Mayra plan otherwise. When Rupali asks Jhende about Vikrant’s whereabouts, he suspects it to be Isha’s plan. While Vikrant gets angry with Jhende for trying to downgrade Isha, Isha foils Rupali and Bipin’s plan.

videos.title: Episode 59
videos.overview: At night, Isha is unable to sleep due to the thoughts of not being able to meet Vikrant. Vikrant goes to his Karjat house and decides to be alone for the next 24 hours. In the morning, Sonya argues with Aaisaheb for being partial towards Vikrant. Falling prey to another fraud, Jaydeep buys so-called ‘Biochemical Petrol Sesame’ that turns mineral water into petrol for INR five crore. A disgusted Sonya locks Jaydeep in a room. Worried, Aaisaheb informs Vikrant about it and he consoles Jaydeep.

videos.title: Episode 60
videos.overview: Isha’s parents wonder what could be the reason behind Isha’s indifferent behaviour. On Aaisaheb’s request, Vikrant tries to give his piece of mind to Sonya, but she doesn’t budge. Later, Sonya appeases Jaydeep and tells him that she wants to see him take all the responsibilities and be successful with his own efforts. The ‘Jogtin’ reminds Isha to go to Amba Devi’s temple in Karjat. Pushpa is unable to ask Vikrant about the temple’s address, but Isha tells her that she has found it.

videos.title: Episode 61
videos.overview: Isha insists on going to the Karjat temple immediately and the Nimkars leave in a cab instead of taking a train. Aaisaheb requests Vikrant to accompany her to the temple, but he refuses and lets Sonya go instead. On seeing only half an hour left in the completion of 24 hours, Isha prays to the goddess. Later, Sarjerao convinces Vikrant to go to the temple. Vikrant spots Isha at the temple, and hides behind a pillar when Isha comes to give Prasad. However, Isha recognises him.

videos.title: Episode 62
videos.overview: Aaisaheb explains to Vikrant that god turns one’s desires into reality, and one should accept it when god does so. Isha concludes that Vikrant doesn’t want to accept the truth. She tells her parents that she will be going to Bangalore the next day as she has been granted a promotion, leaving them shocked. Pushpa decides to call Vikrant to stop Isha’s transfer. A delighted Mayra gives Isha a send-off. In her speech, Isha says she won’t deny her fate, and agrees to go to Bangalore.

videos.title: Episode 63
videos.overview: An emotional Vikrant tells Jhende that he and Isha had come together within 24 hours, but he is guilty of hiding from her. Jhende consoles Vikrant saying they both will get over each other once she goes to Bangalore. Isha confides in Rupali and Bipin that she had met Vikrant in the temple, but he refused to accept her. Isha leaves for Bangalore. On learning that the Bangalore bus has left, Vikrant chases the bus with his car and stops it. Vikrant enters the bus and tries to stop Isha from going.

videos.title: Episode 64
videos.overview: An emotional Isha asks Vikrant why he wants to stop her from going to Bangalore when she has accepted her fate. Mayra and Jhende are worried for not knowing about Vikrant’s whereabouts, and Jhende leaves in search of him. Vikrant compels Isha to get off the bus. Isha confronts Vikrant and tells him that she won’t talk to him until he accepts his feelings. Later, Vikrant shouts at her for asking unknown people for a lift. On seeing her breaking down, he apologises to her and consoles her.

videos.title: Episode 65
videos.overview: Vikrant and Isha go to a nearby hotel and learn that the next bus to Mumbai is in the morning. They decide on spending the night at the hotel, and the receptionist gives them the last vacant room. Isha’s parents get more worried when Jhende visits their house and asks Isha’s whereabouts and whether Vikrant had visited them. Isha again tries to make Vikrant confess his feelings for her but fails. Later, an awkward Vikrant asks Isha to sleep on the bed while he watches over her.

videos.title: Episode 66
videos.overview: Vikrant speaks his heart out while Isha is asleep. Isha pretends to be asleep and hears Vikrant confess his love for her. In the morning, Jhende and Mayra come to pick them up from the hotel. On reaching home, Isha is shocked to see the neighbours at her house and consoles a crying Pushpa. Isha says that her transfer has been cancelled. Later, Mayra breaks down when Jhende tells her about Vikrant and Isha’s love. Mayra grumbles about Vikrant’s behaviour and insults Isha.

videos.title: Episode 67
videos.overview: Mayra tells Jhende that she cannot stand Vikrant falling in love with a middle class girl. When Isha tells her parents that Vikrant had come to pick her up at night, Mr Nimkar gets suspicious and tells Isha to focus on her studies. Vikrant slaps Jhende when he insults Isha in front of him. An excited Isha informs Rupali that Vikrant confessed his feelings to her.

videos.title: Episode 68
videos.overview: An emotional Vikrant apologises to Jhende for raising a hand at him. Jhende warns Mayra against going to London for five days as he fears Vikrant and Isha might come closer. Isha packs an extra lunchbox for Vikrant. At office, Vikrant announces that one of the days of the week will be an open office day, wherein he will sit among the employees and work, and everyone will be allowed to wear casual clothes. Mayra taunts Vikrant over it. Later, everyone is surprised to see Isha in the office.

videos.title: Episode 69
videos.overview: Mayra puts up an act to convince Vikrant to go to London for the ‘World Trade Conference’. Vikrant decides to take Isha along. Mayra tells Jhende to instigate Isha’s parents against the trip. While Isha excitedly informs Mr Nimkar about it, a few colleagues raise their eyebrows at Isha’s selection. Vikrant tells Isha that she deserves to go to London. Later, Jhende visits Isha’s parents to collect documents for Isha’s passport, and indirectly tries to create suspicions in their mind.

videos.title: Episode 70
videos.overview: An elated Isha shares her excitement with Rupali regarding her London trip. Mr Nimkar does not allow Isha to go to London. He refuses to tell the reason to Isha. Later, Mr Nimkar goes to Isha’s office with her to meet Vikrant. Mr Nimkar tells Vikrant that he would not allow Isha to go to London with him as he fears Isha will be badmouthed by everyone. Vikrant empathises with his worries and refuses to take Isha to London. Later, Mr Nimkar reveals to Vikrant that Jhende had cautioned him.

videos.title: Episode 71
videos.overview: Pushpa asks the neighbours what they want from London and collects money from them. However, when Rupali suspects Mr Nimkar cancelling Isha’s trip, Pushpa returns the money. At office, Vikrant tells Mayra and Jhende that Jaydeep will be taking the entire charge of the office in his absence and Isha will be assisting him. Vikrant also taunts Mayra and Jhende for their deeds. Later, Vikrant pacifies Isha and gifts her a necklace, which she refuses to accept. An upset Pushpa admonishes Mr Nimkar.

videos.title: Episode 72
videos.overview: Jaydeep gets Mr Bhokare, a ‘Vastu’ expert, to the office. Mr Bhokare advises changing the direction in which the employees face, to boost the company’s success, and Jaydeep obliges. Vikrant gives Isha a digital watch, through which they can be in touch with each other. Isha tells about it to Rupali. At night, Isha is elated on receiving ‘I miss you’ text from Vikrant on her watch. The next day, while Isha distributes snacks in the office, Mayra reprimands her and complains to Jaydeep.

videos.title: Episode 73
videos.overview: When Isha narrates how the tradition of ‘Faral’, snacks, began during Diwali, Jaydeep tastes the Chaklis and praises them. Jaydeep informs Mayra and Jhende that they will give Chaklis made by Isha’s mother as a corporate gift instead of the diaries, which irks Mayra. Mayra visits Pushpa to place the order for Chaklis and Pushpa is elated to get the advance money. Later, Jaydeep asks the employees for their opinion on his calendar design. Isha tries to oppose the design, but Mayra cuts her off.

videos.title: Episode 74
videos.overview: Isha goes to Jaydeep’s office and voices her disapproval regarding the calendar's design. Mayra gets frustrated debating with Isha over the ideas for the design and leaves. Later, Isha convinces Jaydeep that the demand for the calendar will rise if they make the middle class people connect with it. Mr Nimkar almost sells off the entire ‘Faral’ made for Isha’s office. Isha and Pushpa stop him and explain the issue. Mr Nimkar tells Isha to tell the truth in the office and apologise.

videos.title: Episode 75
videos.overview: Isha tells Mayra on the call that the order cannot be ready by the next morning, but Mayra demands that the order should be delivered in the morning itself. The Nimkars, along with Rupali and Bipin. toil all night to prepare the Chaklis. Isha hurts herself in the process and imagines Vikrant tending to her wound. In the morning, Mayra tries to instigate Jaydeep against Isha, but Isha arrives just in time with the order and foils her plan. Later, Vikrant calls Isha and congratulates her.

videos.title: Episode 76
videos.overview: Isha comes home with the money and hands it over to Mr Nimkar. He decides to buy gifts for everyone who helped them in finishing the order, much to Pushpa’s disappointment. Sonya is irked when Aaisaheb misses Vikrant and refuses to eat the ‘Faral’. A lady comes to buy Chaklis from Pushpa to send them to her sister in Canada, and Isha decides to send them to Vikrant in London. As Isha wants it to be a surprise, Rupali suggests Isha to get Vikrant’s London’s address from office.

videos.title: Episode 77
videos.overview: Sonya orders Bobby to throw away her old sarees. When Jaydeep shows her the new calendar design suggested by Isha, she asks Bobby to throw away that as well. However, Aaisaheb appreciates the calendar design. At office, Isha goes to Jaydeep’s cabin to ask for Vikrant’s London address. Mayra rebukes her and Jaydeep insults Isha’s idea. Just then, Jaydeep learns about the success of the new calendar. An elated Jaydeep announces bonus for all and gives Vikrant’s London address to Isha.

videos.title: Episode 78
videos.overview: Tula Pahate Re is a Marathi romantic drama television show starring Subodh Bhave and Gaytri Datar. They belong to different worlds, they are from different backgrounds and two different decades. This couple will prove that when two souls are meant for each other, they will find their way to meet, even if the two belong to two eras!

videos.title: Episode 79
videos.overview: Aaisaheb is stunned when the ‘Jogtin’ tells her that she had foreseen her visit to the Nimkars. At office, Jaydeep hands over an important file to Isha. Mayra is shocked to learn about Aaisaheb’s visit to Isha. Mayra calls Pushpa and places a huge order of Chaklis worth INR two lakhs. Sonya is furious when Jaydeep gifts her a Rajnandini saree. Pushpa is elated to receive a surprise gift from Mr Nimkar. Later, Isha video-calls Vikrant with the help of Rupali and Bipin and they have a hearty talk.

videos.title: Episode 80
videos.overview: While Vikrant assumes that Isha is wearing the necklace given by him, Isha tells him that Aaisaheb gifted her a similar necklace. Vikrant is about to express his feelings, but the call gets disconnected. Uddhav visits Pushpa to talk about the order and smartly takes a picture of the tender’s copy. At office, Mr Sabnis informs Jaydeep about the tender’s amount being leaked. When Mayra suspects Isha, Jaydeep appoints Mr Paranjpe and Mrs Wadkar for the inquiry, while Mayra confiscates Isha’s phone.

videos.title: Episode 81
videos.overview: Mr Paranjpe and Mrs Wadkar arrive at Isha’s house and inform Isha’s parents that Isha is accused of leaking the company’s tender. During the inspection, they find a bundle of cash under the mattress, but Pushpa and Mr Nimkar deny being aware of it. Seeing the proof, Jaydeep rebukes Isha and calls for legal action against her, much to Mayra’s delight. Vikrant calls Isha, but she is unable to tell him her problem. Mr Nimkar suspects that Pushpa had kept the cash and locks himself in the room.

videos.title: Episode 82
videos.overview: Isha learns that after being given the termination letter, she won’t be allowed any other job. Jaydeep decides to talk to Vikrant before signing Isha’s termination letter, but Mayra and Jhende stop him. When Isha informs Mr Nimkar about the termination letter, he decides to come to her office with Pushpa. While Jaydeep is about to give the letter to Isha, her parents come there and Mr Nimkar begs for forgiveness. Just then, Vikrant shows up and decides to talk to Isha before convicting her.

videos.title: Episode 83
videos.overview: Vikrant summons Isha’s parents to his cabin to interrogate them. Vikrant asks them if any stranger had visited their house. After much insistence, Pushpa reveals that Mayra had placed a big order of Chaklis and had sent a person to confirm the order. Vikrant confronts Mayra and gets out the truth from her. Later, a furious Vikrant asks Mayra the reason behind targeting Isha always. Mayra blurts out that she became insecure since Isha’s joining and admits to loving Vikrant in front of Isha.

videos.title: Episode 84
videos.overview: When Vikrant assumes that Isha has misunderstood him, she reveals that she had heard him express his feelings for her in the hotel. She urges Vikrant to give a clear answer to Mayra. Mr Nimkar wants to meet Vikrant before leaving. Vikrant tells Mayra that he doesn’t have any feelings for her and requests her not to leave the company. Mr Nimkar tells Vikrant that he doesn’t want Isha to work in his company anymore, and Vikrant agrees.

videos.title: Episode 85
videos.overview: Jhende is shocked to learn that Isha has left the job. Vikrant decides to not hide his feelings for Isha from anyone. Just then, Jhende informs Vikrant that Jalindar, who tried to kill Vikrant 15 years ago, has come out of the jail. Jhende decides to tighten Vikrant’s security by seeking police protection. Upset about not being able to meet Vikrant, Isha calls Vikrant and asks him to meet at a café.

videos.title: Episode 86
videos.overview: Frustrated for not being allowed to step out of the office, Vikrant thinks of a plan and orders a pizza. Isha and Rupali make an excuse and go to the café. When the pizza delivery boy arrives, Vikrant takes his uniform and goes to meet Isha. Isha is surprised to see Vikrant in a delivery boy’s uniform. Jhende is irked on learning about it. Isha tells Vikrant that she loves him for his simplicity and not his position. Later, Vikrant is disturbed to spot a person hiding his face with a newspaper.

videos.title: Episode 87
videos.overview: A worried Mr Nimkar looks around for Isha and Rupali. He spots Rupali hiding after seeing him. After getting a call from Rupali, Isha decides to leave. Vikrant notices a person following him and locks him in the washroom. Vikrant and Isha spend romantic moments before bidding goodbye to each other. While Vikrant tells Jhende about Jalindar’s men following him, Isha and Rupali cook up a story at home. Jalindar learns about Vikrant being in love with Isha. Isha tells Rupali about the date.

videos.title: Episode 88
videos.overview: Vikrant realises that Isha could be in danger and orders Jhende to provide security to her. Jalindar calls Isha and tells her that Vikrant is a fraud, and she shouldn’t trust him. Jalindar doesn’t reveal his identity to Isha. The Nimkars feel uncomfortable due to the security outside their house. At night, Isha receives ‘I miss you’ text from Vikrant on her digital watch. The guards get suspicious, but Isha handles the situation. The next morning, Mayra decides to accompany Vikrant for a jog.

videos.title: Episode 89
videos.overview: While cycling, Vikrant talks to Isha on the call, but Mayra assumes that he is talking to her. Isha confides in Rupali about the unknown caller badmouthing Vikrant. Rupali advises Isha to inform Vikrant about it, but Isha doesn’t agree. Jalindar calls Isha again and tries to instigate her against Vikrant by quoting his words. Isha receives a text from an anonymous number while going for the exam. Vikrant meets Isha at the examination venue and brings ‘Prasad’ for her from her favourite temple.

videos.title: Episode 90
videos.overview: Isha shows a chit given by a rickshaw driver to Rupali, who raises doubts over Vikrant. Isha scolds her, saying that she completely trusts Vikrant. Rupali suggests Isha talk to Vikrant and calls him, but later scolds Isha when she doesn’t inform Vikrant about the anonymous call. Vikrant tells Jhende he is sure that Jalindar would try to reach Isha and threaten her. He asks Jhende to find Jalindar at any cost. Vikrant visits Isha and slyly notes down the numbers from her mobile’s call log.

videos.title: Episode 91
videos.overview: Jalindar calls Isha to give her another proof to prove Vikrant a fraud, but she refuses to trust him. She gets shocked when Jalindar sends her a picture of the weird stranger she had come across once. Later, Isha has a nightmare wherein the stranger tries to attack her. Isha wakes up to fever and decides to meet Vikrant to tell him about everything. Later, Isha meets the stranger again. Vikrant throws a party to celebrate the world-wide success of the ‘Chhota Recharge Pack’, and misses Isha.

videos.title: Episode 92
videos.overview: Vikrant comes out of his cabin when he learns of Isha’s visit. Vikrant dances with Isha which amuses everyone. Later, Vikrant takes Isha to his cabin and asks her the reason behind her visit. Meanwhile, an irked Mr Nimkar calls Isha and reprimands her for going to office when she is sick. Isha reveals everything to Vikrant and shows him the picture of the stranger. In the car, Vikrant gives his jacket to Isha and comforts her when she feels cold.

videos.title: Episode 93
videos.overview: Vikrant takes Isha to the stranger and asks her to confront him. The stranger reveals that he was given money for threatening Isha. However, on learning that he was insulting Vikrant, he slaps himself and apologises to her, narrating how Vikrant had helped him. Isha confesses her love for Vikrant. Mr Nimkar voices his suspicions regarding Vikrant’s office. Vikrant confides in the Nimkars about how Jalindar became his enemy. Jhende tells Vikrant that Isha being his weak point is helping Jalindar.

videos.title: Episode 94
videos.overview: Nimkar conveys to Pushpa that he suspected that Isha was in a relationship with someone at her office. Jhende approaches Isha and makes her realise that Jalindar could take ill-advatage of the fact that she is Vikrant's weakness and asks for her promise to break all relations with Vikrant for his safety, to which Isha agreees. Jalindar calls Isha, and she informs him that she had broken all ties with Vikrant but is aghast to learn that Jalindar intended to destroy Vikrant.

videos.title: Episode 95
videos.overview: Jhende arrives at an under-construction building looking for Jalindar but finds a note which reads that it’s not easy to catch him. Isha’s parents discuss love marriage to cheer her up, but Isha says she doesn’t love anyone. Vikrant decides to propose marriage to Isha and shares it with Jhende. Pushpa decides to take up a part-time job, while Isha prepares for a job interview. Elsewhere, Vikrant too rehearses his lines to propose Isha for marriage and goes to her place, surprising her.

videos.title: Episode 96
videos.overview: Isha is glad to see Vikrant pay her a surprise visit and asks him the reason behind it. Vikrant repeatedly fumbles while trying to propose marriage to her. Isha asks him to help her prepare for her job interview and they end up having a fun banter. Just then, Nimkar and Pushpa arrive, and Vikrant asks Isha to rejoin his office, leaving her delighted. Nimkar allows Isha to rejoin Vikrant’s office but lays a few conditions and tries making her realise the class difference between them and Vikrant.

videos.title: Episode 97
videos.overview: Vikrant tells Jhende that he failed to propose marriage to Isha. Isha gets ready to go to work, but decides against going when Rupali reminds her of the promise made to Jhende. However, Rupali convinces Isha to confide in Vikrant about her conversation with Jhende. When Isha reaches office, Jhende tries to stop her from meeting Vikrant, but in vain. Vikrant assures Isha that she can meet him. Later, Isha tells Vikrant about the conditions Mr Nimkar laid down for Isha re-joining the office.

videos.title: Episode 98
videos.overview: Mr Nimkar calls Isha to remind her of the conditions. Jhende tells Vikrant that Isha loves him for his wealth, but Vikrant laughs it off. Jhende bets on proving Isha avaricious and Mayra an appropriate partner for Vikrant. Vikrant summons Isha to his cabin and asks about her expectations from life. Isha wishes to lead a simple life with a small family, irrespective of the size of the house. Later, Jhende slyly tells Isha that Vikrant wants her to shift to a new flat and gives her the address.

videos.title: Episode 99
videos.overview: Jhende claims to have won the bet and tells Vikrant that Isha loves him for his money. However, Jhende is stunned when Vikrant tells him that Isha had returned the flat keys to him. Vikrant gives Jhende another chance. Vikrant tells Mayra about appointing Isha as the head of the new department which will be working on Rajnandini saree’s fabric. Mayra pretends to agree with Vikrant’s decision and mocks Isha. Later, Vikrant announces the news in front of everyone.

videos.title: Episode 100
videos.overview: Vikrant tells Isha that she deserves everything she has. When Jhende expresses his disappointment for not being able to put Isha down, Mayra says that she loves challenges. Isha’s parents throw a small party to celebrate her promotion. During the party, Vikrant calls Isha and the guests raise their eyebrows at it. At night, Mr Nimkar is unable to sleep as he recalls people’s statements about Isha. He asks Isha if she is hiding anything from him, but later tells her that he trusts her.

videos.title: Episode 101
videos.overview: Vikrant tells Aaisaheb that he will be announcing the name of the department head for Rajnandini saree in the board meeting. Mayra tells Isha that her attire is too simple for the occasion and buys her a modern dress. Vikrant turns furious on seeing Isha wear uncomfortable clothes and later reprimands her. Jhende claims to have won the bet and gives Vikrant another chance. Mayra takes Isha to her house and shows off Vikrant’s gifts to her. Vikrant is surprised to not find Isha in the office.

videos.title: Episode 102
videos.overview: Isha makes an excuse and takes the necklace gifted by Vikrant from Pushpa. Next, Isha tells Rupali that she wants to break all ties with Vikrant and asks her to return all the gifts to Vikrant after three days. At the office, Isha learns that Vikrant has a hectic schedule lined up. She purposely sends a lot of texts to Vikrant while he is in the meeting. Further, Isha decides to go for a movie with Bipin to annoy Vikrant. A disturbed Vikrant leaves the meeting and is hurt to see Isha with Bipin.

videos.title: Episode 103
videos.overview: Isha doesn’t go to work and lies to her parents about going to her friend’s engagement. To appease an angry Vikrant, Jaydeep asks Isha to narrate a story to Vikrant over the phone. When Vikrant scolds Isha for not coming to work, she lies about being sick. Later, Vikrant visits Isha’s house and learns about Isha’s lie. On Rupali’s insistence, Isha confides in Vikrant the reason behind her unusual behaviour. Vikrant confronts Jhende and Mayra and decides to propose marriage to Isha the next day.

videos.title: Episode 104
videos.overview: As the Nimkars are about to go to watch a play, Vikrant’s driver arrives and gives an invitation letter to Isha. After leaving, Isha learns that Vikrant has invited her to his house. On entering Vikrant’s house, Isha is amazed by the grandeur. Vikrant reveals his past to Isha, making her emotional. Mr Tillu apprises Isha’s parents of Isha and Vikrant’s affair and asks them to visit Vikrant’s house to see what their daughter is up to. Later, Vikrant gives the ring to Isha on the helicopter.

videos.title: Episode 105
videos.overview: Vikrant takes Isha for a chopper ride and proposes marriage to her mid-air. Isha is speechless on seeing Vikrant’s unique way of proposing marriage to her and accepts his proposal. Mr Nimkar is stunned to see Isha in Vikrant’s arms. Vikrant takes Isha to his house, where they share some wonderful moments amidst a hearty chat. Isha tells Vikrant that she will convince her parents for their marriage. A shattered Mr Nimkar returns home and apprises Pushpa of everything, leaving her devastated.

videos.title: Episode 106
videos.overview: A visibly flummoxed Nimkar tells Pushpa that he trusts Isha and his upbringing. Isha shares her dilemma about their parents’ disapproval with Vikrant owing to their age difference. A disturbed Nimkar blabbers about the consequences of Isha and Vikrant’s relationship. Isha arrives home with a pastry as a mark of celebrating her happiness, but her father’s behaviour leaves her baffled. Jhende is also stunned to learn about Vikrant proposing marriage to Isha and congratulates him.

videos.title: Episode 107
videos.overview: Nimkar takes to reading a religious book and Isha realises that he is disturbed. Later, Jhende apprises Mayra of Vikrant’s marriage proposal to Isha, leaving Mayra stunned. Mayra silently vows to turn the situation in her favour. When Isha leaves for office, Nimkar blesses her. Pushpa learns from Guruji that Isha will marry into a royal family. Rupali visits Vikrant and gives him a parcel, saying Isha has returned his gifts. Vikrant realises it to be a prank but pretends to have fallen for it.

videos.title: Episode 108
videos.overview: Vikrant summons Isha to his cabin and strongly expresses his displeasure to her for sending all her memorable gifts to him. On seeing Isha cry, Vikrant reveals it was a prank. Mayra arrives and tries taunting them about Isha getting additional powers and authority, but Vikrant silences her. He later takes Isha to the cafeteria and instils confidence in her to speak to Mr Nimkar about his marriage proposal. On Vikrant’s advice, Isha behaves sternly with Mayra and takes medicines for Vikrant.

videos.title: Episode 109
videos.overview: Tillu informs Mayra that Mr Nimkar has complete trust on Isha. They vow to break that trust and spoil Isha’s image and reputation. Isha and Vikrant spend a wonderful time, and Vikrant instils confidence in her to talk to her parents about their marriage. Mr Nimkar talks to Isha about registering her name in a marriage bureau, leaving her baffled. Tillu badmouths about Isha to the neighbours. Jhende and Mayra embarrass Isha in office.

videos.title: Episode 110
videos.overview: Mr Nimkar lashes out at Mr Sawant when he badmouths Isha. Mr Nimkar’s boss insults him for venting out his frustration on the customers. A hesitant Isha calls Mr Nimkar and tells him that Vikrant wants to speak to him regarding her future, but his reply stuns Isha and Vikrant. Pushpa asks Isha whether she is hiding something from her father. Ranjana influences Pushpa to sell off their house. Taking Jhende’s advice, Vikrant decides to send Aaisaheb to Isha’s house to talk about the marriage.

videos.title: Episode 111
videos.overview: Mr Nimkar is shocked to see a young girl walk into his shop with her husband, who is of her father’s age. Jhende captures Mr Nimkar and forcefully takes him to Vikrant’s office. Jhende threatens Mr Nimkar to say yes to Vikrant’s questions. On learning about it, Vikrant apologises to Mr Nimkar and orders the driver to drop him home safely. Vikrant rebukes Jhende for his behaviour and warns him against coming between Isha and him. Later, Vikrant tries to comfort a frightened Isha.

videos.title: Episode 112
videos.overview: Jhende gives an apology letter to Vikrant and asks him to give it to Mr Nimkar. But, Vikrant tears up the letter and asks to be left alone. After Isha reaches home, Mr Nimkar questions her about her relationship with Vikrant. When Isha remains mute, he tells her that Vikrant is misusing her and everyone is badmouthing them. Isha is shocked to learn that Mr Nimkar had seen her with Vikrant on the chopper. Mr Nimkar is devastated when Isha owns up to her deeds. Later, Vikrant visits Isha’s house.

videos.title: Episode 113
videos.overview: Vikrant tries to apologise to Mr Nimkar, but he shuts the door on Vikrant’s face. Vikrant decides to stand right there until he opens the door. Isha pleads with her parents to listen to Vikrant, but in vain, which makes Isha cry. The neighbours badmouth Vikrant on seeing him standing at the Nimkars’ door for long. The next morning, Mr Nimkar sees Vikrant standing at the same place. Vikrant admits to loving Isha and vows to answer all the questions of Mr Nimkar before getting married to Isha.

videos.title: Episode 114
videos.overview: Isha and Pushpa celebrate Mr Nimkar’s birthday. Mr Nimkar receives a bouquet and a gift from Vikrant which makes him angry. Mr Nimkar doesn’t accept the gift and leaves for work without the lunchbox. Pushpa tells Isha that she will always support Mr Nimkar in any stand he takes. Jhende justifies his actions to Vikrant and later, apologises to Isha for misbehaving with Mr Nimkar. Pushpa is keen on seeing Mr Nimkar’s gift. Vikrant permits Isha to leave office early for the birthday dinner.

videos.title: Episode 115
videos.overview: The Nimkars go out for dinner and are surprised to find the restaurant empty. The waiter tells them that a special chef has joined on the occasion of Mr Nimkar’s birthday. Impressed by the food, Pushpa wishes to compliment the chef. Mr Nimkar is annoyed to learn that Vikrant was the chef, but Vikrant makes him cut the cake and subtly proposes to become a part of Nimkar family through the gift. The next day, Isha’s picture is published in the newspaper, but Mr Nimkar feels it’s Vikrant’s favour.

videos.title: Episode 116
videos.overview: Mr Nimkar’s boss pesters him to ask Isha to give a massive discount on the Rajnandini sarees' and sells them at 50% discount. At the office, Mihir and Mrs Wadkar taunt Isha while Mr Paranjpe and Sapna congratulate her. Mr Nimkar decides to mortgage his house to make up for his boss’s losses. Later, Mr Nimkar lambasts Vikrant for cancelling the Rajnandini sarees’ dealership with his shop, but Isha gives an explanation. Mr Nimkar decides to meet the prospective grooms for Isha's marriage.

videos.title: Episode 117
videos.overview: Pushpa tries to talk to Mr Nimkar about Vikrant, but he evades the topic. At office, Vikrant asks Mr Paranjpe, Mrs Wadkar and FM for their views on love marriage. Mihir is irked to see Vikrant giving importance to FM. Mr Nimkar dislikes the four suitors owing to their selfish and exploitative motives. Later, Vikrant arrives as the fifth suitor. Further, Vikrant answers all the questions that Mr Nimkar had put forth and asks him to consider his proposal to marry Isha.

videos.title: Episode 118
videos.overview: Pushpa tells Isha that it’s her responsibility to get Isha and Vikrant married. Vikrant invites Isha to celebrate the good news and Christmas with him. The next morning, Mr Nimkar allows Isha to go out with Vikrant. Mr Nimkar leaves with Pushpa to follow Isha and Vikrant. Mr Nimkar’s suspicions are proved wrong when he sees Vikrant take Isha to an old age home, where they happily feed cake to the old people. Later, Isha’s parents secretly watch Isha and Vikrant feeding cake to each other.

videos.title: Episode 119
videos.overview: Isha feels lucky to have found Vikrant owing to his loving and caring nature. Pushpa praises Vikrant for being down-to-earth, but Mr Nimkar disregards it. Pushpa gets angry and tells Mr Nimkar that he hasn’t done anything for Isha as a father which hurts him. Vikrant drops Isha home and gives her a cake to celebrate Christmas with her family. Pushpa tells Isha that Mr Nimkar left the house in anger. Later, Mr Nimkar returns home drunk and criticises himself, hurting Pushpa and Isha.

videos.title: Episode 120
videos.overview: Isha sends a letter to Vikrant, who is shocked to read that Isha wants to put an end to their relationship as it’s hurting her close ones. Isha confides in Rupali about her decision, but Rupali disapproves of it. Just then, Vikrant drives Isha away and rebukes her for taking the decisions regarding their relationship alone. The Jogtin visits Pushpa and asks for alms, assuring that everything will be fine. On Vikrant’s insistence, Isha tries to talk to her father, but he avoids her.

videos.title: Episode 121
videos.overview: Pushpa packs Isha’s bag and tells Isha that she is taking her to Pinky’s house in Pune. However, Pushpa takes Isha to meet Vikrant and asks Vikrant to take Isha away and marry her. Vikrant refuses saying he will wait until Mr Nimkar consents to it. Mr Nimkar calls Pinky and realises that Pushpa lied. After Isha and Pushpa return home, Mr Nimkar confronts them regarding their whereabouts and Pushpa divulges everything. Later, Mr Nimkar reveals to Pushpa about Vikrant’s first marriage.

videos.title: Episode 122
videos.overview: Mr Nimkar thinks that Vikrant has cheated on them by not telling them about his ex-wife, but Isha says that Vikrant never wanted to hide it, and hence, he mentioned the same in the file. Mr Nimkar asks Isha whether Vikrant’s family would accept her the way Vikrant does. Just then, Aaisaheb arrives with Vikrant and tells Mr Nimkar that Vikrant never thought of a second marriage until he met Isha and he is highly eligible. After everyone’s reassurance, Mr Nimkar finally agrees for the marriage.

videos.title: Episode 123
videos.overview: Aaisaheb informs all the Saranjame family members about Vikrant’s marriage. Sonya is disappointed due to Isha’s low status, but Aaisaheb and Vikrant convince her to accompany them to the Nimkars’ house to talk about the particulars of the marriage. Vikrant apprises Mayra and Jhende about the marriage proceedings and asks Mayra to plan a simple wedding. The Nimkars are busy with the preparations of welcoming the Saranjames. After reaching the Nimkars’ house, Vikrant introduces his family members.

videos.title: Episode 126
videos.overview: Vikrant’s family members give suggestions for the design of the Mangalsutra, but Vikrant asks them to talk to Mayra. Pinky arrives at the Nimkars’ house and announces that she’ll be staying until Isha’s wedding. On Vikrant’s instructions, Mayra comes to Isha’s house to show the shortlisted Mangalsutra to Isha. On Jhende’s insistence, Vikrant himself decides to finalise the Mangalsutra with Isha and calls her to the office. Vikrant is irked to learn that Pushpa and Pinky have accompanied Isha.

videos.title: Episode 127
videos.overview: After calling Isha to his cabin, Vikrant escapes with her from the fire exit and takes her to buy the Mangalsutra. Isha makes Vikrant choose her Mangalsutra while she buys a bracelet for him with her own money. Pinky gets annoyed as she and Pushpa had to wait and couldn’t even select the Mangalsutra. She warns Isha against meeting Vikrant before marriage. Rupali and Isha share a friendly banter. The next day, the Nimkars, along with Pinky, go to Vikrant’s office to see the invitation card.

videos.overview: Tula Pahate Re is a Marathi romantic drama television show starring Subodh Bhave and Gaytri Datar. They belong to different worlds, they are from different backgrounds and two different decades. This couple will prove that when two souls are meant for each other, they will find their way to meet, even if the two belong to two eras!

videos.title: Episode 129
videos.overview: Pinky says she will come for the ‘Vyahi Bhojan’ only if she gets an invitation. Isha’s parents distribute Isha’s wedding invites in their locality and their neighbours are overawed by the grandeur of the invitation. Aaisaheb calls Mr Nimkar to give them a special invitation for the ‘Vyahi Bhojan’. Pinky is upset as Aaisaheb didn’t call her, but Isha and Mr Nimkar trick her into accompanying them. The Nimkars are mesmerised to see the Saranjame house. Sonya prepares street food for the Nimkars.

videos.title: Episode 130
videos.overview: Everyone picks the clothes of their choice. Pinky doesn’t like the sarees individually and demands to have the designs of five different sarees in one. The designer refuses, but Vikrant buys their company and orders the designer to make customisation possible. When Vikrant shows Isha her wedding saree, she tells him that she wants to wear the Rajnandini saree gifted by her father instead. Later, the Nimkars are troubled by the paparazzi and Vikrant orders Mayra and Jhende to look after the same.

videos.title: Episode 131
videos.overview: Ranjana badmouths Isha in front of the paparazzi. Vikrant encourages Isha to face the paparazzi by giving them their answers. People threaten to blacken Isha’s face when she comes out of the house and bombard her with questions. Isha patiently answers all the questions and explains how her and Vikrant’s relationship is pure. She reiterates that love knows no boundaries. Everyone applauds Isha. The next day, the family members and neighbours gift Isha her favourite things, making her emotional.

videos.title: Episode 132
videos.overview: Tula Pahate Re is a Marathi romantic drama television show starring Subodh Bhave and Gaytri Datar. They belong to different worlds, they are from different backgrounds and two different decades. This couple will prove that when two souls are meant for each other, they will find their way to meet, even if the two belong to two eras!

videos.title: Episode 133
videos.overview: The 'Mehendi' ceremony of Vikrant and Isha starts with a trivia of their love story which builds excitement amongst all. Myra makes each person enact a situation from the couple's love story. Vikrant volunteers for his turn and takes the opportunity to draw 'Mehendi', henna tattoo on Isha's hands after a romantic performance. At the end of the day, the men enjoy a bonfire and drinks while Jhende helps them. Amidst this, Vikrant and Isha share a sweet moment under the sky.

videos.title: Episode 134
videos.overview: Vikrant asks Isha to call him by his name. She tells Vikrant that she wishes to have their home at the wedding venue. Vikrant declares that he’s won the 'mehendi' bet and romances Isha. Late at night, Isha wakes up in a shock after having a nightmare and encounters Aaisaheb outside her room. Pushpa panics after not finding any pestle to prepare the turmeric, but Mayra calms her down by showing the imported samples of turmeric. Rupali makes Vikrant jealous by raving about Isha’s beauty.

videos.title: Episode 135
videos.overview: Jaydeep announces that he wants to make a museum of the Saranjame family members, which will have their wax statues. Mayra engages Isha and Vikrant in an interesting ring-finding game. The Nimkars and Saranjames have a dance competition during the 'sangeet'. The next day, Rupali and Bipin manage to hide Vikrant’s shoes, much to Sonya’s disappointment. Vikrant faints during the wedding proceedings as he forgets to take his medicine. Later, Vikrant amends a few customs of the wedding.

videos.title: Episode 136
videos.overview: At the post event press conference, Vikrant and Isha arrive for the very first time as a married couple. Jhende consoles Myra and appreciates her courage as she weeps profusely at the wedding event. Amidst weeping family members, a teary-eyed Isha bids farewell to the Nimkars while Vikrant assures them that the Saranjame family would always keep her happy. Later, Aaisaheb and the rest of the Saranjame family members welcome Isha to their residence with great enthusiasm.

videos.title: Episode 137
videos.overview: Isha serves a dish to all the friends, relatives and colleagues. Rupali calls her to ask about her whereabouts while the others retire to their rooms. Isha knocks at the door of a room but Vikrant asks her to wait for some time. Vikrant's servant escorts her to a room where she relaxes and recalls some sweet memories. Vikrant walks in and tries to talk but finds Isha fast asleep. Later, Vikrant calls Jhende as he gets disturbed after finding a gift from Jalinder in his room.

videos.title: Episode 138
videos.overview: Vikrant gets ready for office and Isha wakes up to realise that she's late. She waves him goodbye, and then, accidentally enters Sonya's room. Aaisaheb meets her and tells her that she is happy with Isha's arrival in Vikrant's life. Mayra gets upset with Vikrant for shouting at her during a call. Mr. Nimkar is shocked and tensed on learning about the marriage expenses from Mayra. Jaydeep and Isha discover a new relationship between them. An infuriated Vikrant orders Jhende to find Jalindar.

videos.title: Episode 139
videos.overview: Jaydeep makes Isha sit on a chair next to Vikrant's, which makes Aaisaheb happy and Sonya bored. Isha readies the dinner with Manda and Bobby while Sonya makes fun of her. Sitting in the office, Vikrant constantly calls Jhende for updates on finding Jalindar. He then reaches home late and feels sorry seeing Isha waiting for him. The next day starts with the Saranjames offering prayers. Elsewhere, Mr Nimkar collects money for selling their house and this makes Pushpa break into tears.

videos.title: Episode 140
videos.overview: Isha seeks Aaisaheb’s permission to make sesame laddus for everyone and calls Pushpa for the recipe. Isha surprises Vikrant, who later gets upset when Isha enquires about the closed room. Mr Nimkar pleads with Pushpa, Rupali and Bipin to not tell Isha about selling the house. Isha stuns the Saranjame ladies by finding the old moulds to make the sweets. Isha gets emotional reminiscing about the Sankranti memories and Jaydeep plans a surprise for her.

videos.title: Episode 141
videos.overview: Mayra disapproves of Vikrant’s attire. Vikrant reprimands Mayra for under-estimating Isha. Jaydeep calls Vikrant and invites him for the kite festival. Mayra is proven wrong when Isha calls Vikrant to remind him to take his medicine. Isha distributes ‘Tilguds’ to everyone, but Sonya doesn’t accept it. Later, Isha challenges Vikrant to identify the special ‘Tilgud’ that she made for him, and he wins the challenge. After welcoming everyone to the kite festival, Jaydeep gifts a gold kite to Isha.

videos.title: Episode 142
videos.overview: Isha cuts her finger by mistake during the kite-flying competition. She encounters Jalindar while chasing the kite and gets shocked. Vikrant fails to catch Jalindar. Later, Jalindar calls on Isha’s phone and threatens Vikrant. Vikrant fires his security and calls for police protection. Isha invites her parents for her ‘Haldi Kumkum’. The next day, Aaisaheb asks Isha to wear a 'Rajnandini' saree for the ‘Haldi Kumkum’ and Vikrant compliments Isha’s looks.

videos.title: Episode 143
videos.overview: Mr Nimkar and Pushpa bid adieu to their neighbours. Everyone becomes emotional and tries in vain to convince them to stay. The ‘Jogtin’ visits the Saranjame house and asks Isha to visit Goddess Amba’s temple before the problems take a toll on her. Vikrant calls Isha and reprimands her for stepping out of the house and not keeping her phone with her. Isha’s parents reach for the ‘Haldi Kumkum’ and keep their luggage away to avoid Isha’s questions. Pushpa brings ‘Poliche Ladu’ for Isha's in-laws.

videos.title: Episode 144
videos.overview: Isha’s parents leave after the ‘Haldi Kumkum’. Despite Mr Nimkar’s refusal, Vikrant asks the driver to drop them home. However, they get off the car midway but ask the driver to lie that he has dropped them home. A stranger offers food to them. They decide to spend the night at Goddess Amba’s temple. When a worried Isha calls them, Mr Nimkar switches the phone off. The next morning, when Isha and Vikrant visit the temple, Pushpa spots Isha, but Mr Nimkar warns her against talking to Isha.

videos.title: Episode 145
videos.overview: Pushpa sends Mr Nimkar away and calls Isha. However, Mr Nimkar catches her calling and switches the phone off. Mr Nimkar hides behind the beggars while Isha and Vikrant distribute clothes to them. Isha feels her parents’ presence in the temple, but Vikrant tells her that it’s because she is missing them. Mayra shows Isha’s cabin to Vikrant, who later puts his and Isha’s picture frame in the meeting room. Will Isha learn about her parents’ truth after visiting her maternal house?

videos.title: Episode 146
videos.overview: Mayra expresses her disapproval about Vikrant not maintaining uniformity in the rules and favouring Isha. Vikrant says that he is doing so as he loves Isha. Isha searches for her father, but cannot find him anywhere. When Isha doesn’t answer Vikrant’s calls, Mayra says that Isha doesn’t value him. Vikrant lashes out at Isha for making everyone wait for her. The picture frame in the meeting room falls and breaks, leaving Vikrant disturbed. Later, Isha tells Vikrant about her parents.

videos.title: Episode 147
videos.overview: Vikrant suspects Jalindar to be behind the sudden disappearance of Isha’s parents, and orders Jhende to find him at any cost. Jaydeep informs Vikrant that an unidentified bag has been found in the house. After reaching home, Vikrant finds cash in the bag. After interrogating the guards, Vikrant learns that the bag was left by Isha’s parents. Isha cries the whole night while Vikrant tries to comfort her. When Jaydeep suggests buying a satellite to locate Isha’s parents, Vikrant reprimands him.

videos.title: Episode 148
videos.overview: Jhende’s men find Isha’s parents. An emotional Isha expresses her disappointment to her parents for keeping her in the dark about everything. Vikrant returns the house to Isha’s parents without hurting their sentiments and gives them a piece of his mind, and they apologise to Isha. Isha thanks Vikrant and kisses him. At the office, everyone notices the lipstick mark on Vikrant’s cheek. At home, Isha decides to prepare ‘Poliche Ladu’ for Vikrant, despite the servants’ refusal.

videos.title: Episode 149
videos.overview: Isha offers ‘Poliche Ladu’ to Vikrant, who tells her that he doesn’t like them much, much to Isha’s surprise. Sarjerao gets the rice cooker for Isha, who then learns that Mayra takes care of the expenses of the entire house and the overall diet for all. Isha sends the ‘Poliche Ladu’ to her parents and makes them happy. Pushpa decides to send Kheer for Vikrant in return. Sonya cribs about Mayra and Isha to Vikrant. Isha prepares Indian breakfast for Vikrant, keeping his calorie count in mind.

videos.title: Episode 150
videos.overview: Sonya is surprised to see Isha bring tea for her. Isha suggests Sonya to take the house’s responsibility, and she obliges, thinking it will create a rift between Mayra and Isha. Isha’s parents visit the Saranjame house and get ‘kheer’ for Vikrant. Vikrant calls Isha’s parents to his room and asks Mr Nimkar to not call him sir and make him feel like an outsider. Sonya surprises everyone by taking charge of the kitchen. Mayra learns that Isha has rejected the exotic vegetables ordered by her

videos.title: Episode 151
videos.overview: The local vegetable vender comes to the Saranjame house. While buying the vegetables, Isha calls Pushpa and asks her to bargain with the vender. Later, the guards throw the vender out of the house on Mayra’s orders. At the dining table, Isha suggests Vikrant to give the house’s responsibility to Sonya and he obliges. Mr Nimkar thinks about taking up a part-time job. At office, Vikrant hands over the Khandelwal project to Mayra and tells her about giving the house’s responsibility to Sonya.

videos.title: Episode 152
videos.overview: Vikrant calls for a meeting and hands over the chequebook used for the house’s expenses to Sonya. A delighted Sonya celebrates her happiness with Jaydeep and Bobby by cutting a cake. Later, Sonya calls for a meeting and asks everyone if they trust her. Further, as the leader of the house, she asks Vikrant to open the closed room for everyone. When Vikrant refuses, she asks him to open it for Isha as it’s her right. Vikrant gets furious at Isha and angrily gives her the keys of the room.
