videos.title: Episode 155
videos.overview: Mr Nimkar and Pushpa worry about making Vikrant comfortable. The men in the neighbourhood try to hear Isha and Vikrant’s conversation, and they purposely talk about their honeymoon. Jaydeep misses Isha, who informs Aaisaheb about their stay at her maternal house. Isha gets surprised to see Vikrant wear a ‘lungi’. Rupali and Bipin take the couple to eat a special ‘paan’. Isha’s parents sleep outside the house and insist the couple to sleep inside. Later, the couple shares a candid conversation.

videos.title: Episode 156
videos.overview: After spending a few romantic moments with each other, Isha takes Vikrant to the terrace, where they reminisce about some candid moments from the past. In the morning, Vikrant and Isha leave to go to the Saranjame house. Pushpa calls Aaisaheb and praises Vikrant. Aaisaheb asks Mr Paranjpe to come home in the evening with the lawyer and some important papers. She informs all the family members about the meeting through a text. Later, Isha gets some strange feelings regarding the meeting.

videos.title: Episode 157
videos.overview: In the meeting, Aaisaheb announces that she wishes to transfer the Saranjame property to Vikrant. However, the lawyer says that according to the legal papers, she can transfer the property to anyone except Vikrant. This angers Aaisaheb. Vikrant says that he himself had asked Dadasaheb to include this clause to win his trust. Jhende leaves the meeting in anger and Vikrant chases him. When Vikrant asks Jhende the reason for being upset, he slaps Vikrant.

videos.title: Episode 158
videos.overview: Vikrant tells Jhende that he is lucky to have Isha in his life. He adds that he married Isha and won her and her family’s trust in order to use Isha to acquire the Saranjame property. The next morning, Isha gets scared listening to the gunshots and Aaisaheb tells her that Vikrant does shooting when in stress. Isha goes out and stops Vikrant, who apologises to her for breaking her trust. However, Isha says that she loves him even more after learning that he doesn’t own the property.

videos.title: Episode 159
videos.overview: When Jhende calls an apple a banana and a banana an apple, Mayra considers him ill. Jaydeep tells Vikrant that he doesn’t deserve the property. Vikrant concludes saying that the title of the property is not a concern. Jaydeep doesn’t take the pen drive loaded with property details. Jhende asks Vikrant how he will prove that Isha is Rajnandini’s reincarnation. Vikrant anticipates Isha's each move when she comes to return the pen drive. He tells Jhende that he could mould Isha the way he wants.

videos.title: Episode 160
videos.overview: Vikrant gets angry when the employees discuss about apples and bananas, while Mayra plans for Jhende’s psychological tests. Later, Vikrant narrates to Jhende how he won Dadasaheb’s trust and was planning to acquire the property through Rajnandini. However, her sudden demise left him disturbed, until he met Isha and confirmed that he can prove her Rajnandini’s reincarnation. He shows Jhende the newspaper article that gave him hope. He reveals his evil intentions behind winning the Nimkars’ trust.

videos.title: Episode 161
videos.overview: Pushpa asks her neighbours for solutions on reducing stress and gets surprised with Mahimkar’s suggestion. Elsewhere, Jhende tries to make Vikrant understand that he can get the property without proving Isha Rajnandini’s reincarnation, but Vikrant says that he has waited long enough. Vikrant further decides to make Isha join office again. On Jhende’s request, Aaisaheb asks Isha to join office. However, Vikrant says that he doesn’t have stress and disapproves of Isha helping him out.

videos.title: Episode 162
videos.overview: Jhende questions Vikrant for opposing Isha’s decision when he actually wants her to come to the office. While Vikrant is confident that Isha will come to the office, she decides otherwise. Vikrant fixes a meeting with Khandelwal the next morning and pretends to have forgotten it in order to prove that he is in stress. At the office, while Vikrant awaits Isha, Jaydeep shows up and tells Vikrant that he has come to share his workload on Isha’s suggestion. Vikrant asks Jaydeep to hold the meetings.

videos.title: Episode 163
videos.overview: To Vikrant and Jhende's utter disbelief, Jaydeep handles the meeting exceptionally well. However, upon Mr. Milind's insistence, when Jaydeep agrees to meet him for a few minutes, Milind manages to lure him into coming for the demo of one of his products and Jaydeep ends up postponing a meeting due to it. Meanwhile, Isha informs Aaisaheb about Jaydeep's progress in the office. Upon Vikrant's instruction, Milind finally manages to cajole Jaydeep into buying the product at an exorbitant price.

videos.title: Episode 164
videos.overview: Milind isn’t satisfied with the deal, but Jhende threatens him with a gun. Jaydeep gets a time-machine and asks Vikrant to try it in order to relieve his stress. However, Jaydeep feels dejected as the machine doesn’t work. Vikrant blames himself for the loss of INR 3.5 crore. Aaisaheb chides Isha for sending Jaydeep to help out Vikrant instead of going herself. Later, Isha apologises to Vikrant. The next day, much to Jhende’s surprise, Isha shows up at office.

videos.title: Episode 165
videos.overview: Vikrant announces to the office staff about Isha re-joining the office. Isha is overwhelmed to see her new cabin. She calls Mr Nimkar and informs him about having a cabin of her own. A dejected Mihir tells Mayra that he cannot accept Isha as her boss and gives his resignation. After learning about it from Mayra, Vikrant apprises Isha of the same. Later, Isha asks Mihir to take his resignation back and tells him that she will only sit in the cabin after proving herself.

videos.title: Episode 166
videos.overview: Jhende worries about Isha gaining popularity, but Vikrant relaxes him. Isha tells Mayra that she would like to be called Mrs. Saranjame. Later, Mayra, Mrs. Wadkar and Mr. Paranjpe inform Isha that the Rajnandini factory in Borivali is incurring losses, hence they will have to reduce the workers. They ask Isha to take the action soon. Isha confides in her father about the workload. Mayra feels Isha isn’t capable of taking quick action. Vikrant asks Isha to take a break and meet him.

videos.title: Episode 167
videos.overview: Vikrant makes coffee for Isha. She tries to seek his help to take the factory’s decision, but he asks her to take a decision on her own. Just then, she gets inspired reading a message in the ‘Fortune Cookies’. She decides to study the company’s records of the past 25 years, which surprises everyone. Jaydeep looks for something interesting to gift Isha. Later, Isha takes the files home and decides to study them all night. Vikrant tries to get intimate with her, but she asks him to sleep.

videos.title: Episode 168
videos.overview: Isha is happy to see Vikrant sleeping in peace and doesn’t wake him up on time. She instructs Aaisaheb not to disturb him until he wakes up on his own and hands his phone to her. Everyone in the office is surprised at Vikrant being late. Jhende pleads with Aaisaheb to wake Vikrant up. Later at the office, Paranjpe praises Isha’s work in front of Vikrant, who finds it ordinary. When Isha calls Vikrant to apologise, he makes her say 'I love you' loudly, after which, Mayra summons her to her cabin.

videos.title: Episode 169
videos.overview: Mayra fusses about Isha making a lot of errors in her work. Jhende suggests Vikrant to insult Isha in front of everyone. An excited Rupali shares Isha’s result with the Nimkars, making them feel proud. At the office, Vikrant declares Isha as the best employee of the month and praises her work. Isha rebukes Vikrant for being partial towards her. Ganya tells Mr Nimkar that his job is at risk since their shop doesn’t have the dealership of Rajnandini sarees. Vikrant badmouths Isha and her parents.

videos.title: Episode 170
videos.overview: Isha’s parents visit her office with sweets and share the news of her being a graduate with everyone. Everyone congratulates Isha. Mr Nimkar tells Isha and Mayra that he wants the dealership of the Rajnandini sarees back, but they ask him to speak to Vikrant. Mr Nimkar tells Vikrant that he wants to sell the shop to his boss in order to get the dealership back and Vikrant supports his decision. At home, Jaydeep suggests celebrating Isha’s result. Aaisaheb is disturbed after reading something.

videos.title: Episode 171
videos.overview: Jhende asks Aaisaheb why she is disturbed. A shocked Aaisaheb tells him that Isha has got the exact same percentage as Rajnandini. Vikrant gives a surprise to Isha. He also gifts her a slam book. In the office, Mayra asks Isha to sign some legal documents, but she refuses to sign it before reading it. When Jhende complains to Vikrant about it, he says that it’s a part of his plan. Mr Nimkar sells his shop to his boss. Later, Isha gets an idea from Vikrant while talking to him about her parents.

videos.title: Episode 172
videos.overview: Mihir reminds Isha to sign the documents, but she says that she is thinking of a solution. While shopping, Jaydeep tells Sonya that he wants to assist Isha since he has a lot to learn from her and Sonya supports him. Isha calls for a meeting and puts forth a solution for the factory problem. She says that they can sell off the loss-making unit and shift its employees to the other unit instead of removing them. Vikrant approves the idea. Isha plans a Sunday surprise for the family with Jaydeep.

videos.title: Episode 173
videos.overview: Everyone in the Saranjame house finds a note saying they need to come to a room without telling anyone about it. However, everyone lands up gathering in the same room. Isha and Jaydeep reveal that the note was written by them and share their plan of doing a collective activity every Sunday. All of them decide to play cricket. Isha sprains her leg while fielding and Vikrant calls out Rajnandini’s name, shocking everyone. Later, Vikrant carries Isha to the room and tends to her injury.

videos.title: Episode 174
videos.overview: Vikrant asks Isha to punish him with a hunter for calling her Rajnandini. When she refuses, Vikrant punishes himself. Aaisaheb tells Jhende that she sees traits of Rajnandini in Isha. Vikrant tells Isha that he had pledged not to think about Rajnandini. Jaydeep tells Sonya that he feels a certain warmth in Isha. Vikrant decides to be unreachable throughout the day to make Isha feel alone at the office. Mihir informs Mayra about the labour contractor being livid with Isha’s decision.

videos.title: Episode 175
videos.overview: Isha learns that Vikrant has gone to meet her parents. The contract labourers arrive at office and criticise Isha’s decision. Isha asks them to give their problems in writing, but they don’t budge and threaten to go on a strike if their demands are not met in a day. Vikrant orders a pizza for Mr Nimkar instead of taking his tiffin to him. He sarcastically compliments Pushpa’s culinary skills. Vikrant learns about Isha having a nightmare every ‘Ashtami’, which proves to be a coincidence.

videos.title: Episode 176
videos.overview: Mr Paranjpe explains to Isha why the contract labourers have a problem with shutting the unit down. Isha reaches home and learns that Vikrant isn’t home yet. However, Isha is surprised to find Vikrant in the room. Vikrant warns Isha against talking about work at home. Isha has a nightmare and behaves strangely. When Aaisaheb and Jaydeep come to her room, she tells them that it’s a usual occurrence at the night of ‘Ashtami’. A shocked Aaisaheb confirms the same with Mr Nimkar.

videos.title: Episode 177
videos.overview: Tula Pahate Re is a Marathi romantic drama television show starring Subodh Bhave and Gaytri Datar. They belong to different worlds, they are from different backgrounds and two different decades. This couple will prove that when two souls are meant for each other, they will find their way to meet, even if the two belong to two eras!

videos.title: Episode 178
videos.overview: Vikrant rebukes the entire staff for being unaware of the ongoing fraud despite working with the company for several years. Mihir raises a doubt at Isha’s stand, but she says that she’s done the research. Jaydeep gets Isha’s parents to the office and asks Isha to enter the cabin since she has proven her worth. Aaisaheb is upset as Isha didn’t solve the matter the way she was expecting. Even Vikrant is surprised at Isha’s intelligence. Rajesh and Sudhir visit the person responsible for the fraud.

videos.title: Episode 179
videos.overview: Rajesh and Sudhir consult Vikrant for their future plan of action. Vikrant gets irked to find Isha studying the files at home. He tells Jhende that Isha will pay the price for delving deep into the matter. The next day, everyone treats Isha with respect at the office. Vikrant comforts Isha when she gets worried at not being able to find the name of the fraudster. When Vikrant fires the labour contractors, Isha tells him that they should keep them on their jobs in order to reach the fraudster.

videos.title: Episode 180
videos.overview: Vikrant thanks Isha for reminding him of his values. At night, Vikrant calls Mayra and says that he misses her. The next day, Mayra comes to office decked up and eagerly waits for Vikrant. Vikrant gets frustrated on learning about a get-together from Aaisaheb. Sonya congratulates Isha and thanks her for bringing a change in Jaydeep. The Nimkars, Bipin and Rupali come to the Saranjame house and Aaisaheb tells them that she will be gifting Rajnandini’s ‘Tanmani’, a Maharashtrian ornament, to Isha.

videos.title: Episode 181
videos.overview: Vikrant asks Mayra to schedule the monthly meeting the same day. He ignores Isha’s calls throughout the meeting. Isha gives a tour around the Saranjame bungalow to Rupali and Bipin. Later, Isha takes them to her room, where they have a hearty conversation. Elsewhere, Vikrant praises Mayra and asks her to not lose her hold on the company. Isha’s parents tell Aaisaheb that Isha is lucky to have such caring in-laws. Sonya tries to teach the right pronunciation of her name to Isha’s parents.

videos.title: Episode 182
videos.overview: On everyone’s insistence, Isha agrees to have dinner in Vikrant’s absence. Late at night, Vikrant arrives and rebukes Isha for eating without him. On seeing Isha wearing Rajnandini’s ‘Tanmani’, he takes it away from her. An emotional Vikrant returns the ‘Tanmani’ to Aaisaheb and warns her against seeing Rajnandini in Isha. Later, Vikrant angrily leaves the house. The next day, Aaisaheb asks Isha to go to her parents' for a few days. At office, FM helps Isha retrieve a file she forgets to save.

videos.title: Episode 183
videos.overview: After welcoming Isha, Mr Nimkar surprises her with her favourite snack. The next morning, Isha offers to prepare breakfast. Pushpa repeatedly asks Isha whether her in-laws talk about Rajnandini, which irks Isha. After a hearty chat, Rupali too asks Isha about the same, but she evades the topic. At the office, when Isha says that she is unaware of Vikrant’s whereabouts, Mayra feels that she is hiding it owing to her jealousy while Jhende suspects Jalindar behind it. Later, Isha misses Vikrant.

videos.title: Episode 184
videos.overview: On learning about FM’s interest in doing a computer course, Isha announces that the company will sponsor the fees of the course. Isha tells Mayra and Jhende that she wants to go for lunch with them. When Aaisaheb chides Jaydeep for not being bothered for Vikrant, Sonya chastises her for entertaining Vikrant’s selfish behaviour and never asking him for an explanation. Isha lies about Vikrant’s whereabouts to her parents. During the lunch, Isha asks Jhende and Mayra about their past.

videos.title: Episode 185
videos.overview: Sonya takes Jaydeep to the Nimkars’ house. On learning about Sonya and Jaydeep’s visit from Pushpa, Isha leaves for home in a hurry. Meanwhile, Sonya reveals to Isha’s parents about Vikrant leaving the house in anger. After Isha arrives, Pushpa confronts her for hiding it from them. Isha promises to handle the situation wisely the next time onwards. Elsewhere, Aaisaheb worries for Isha. Jaydeep expresses his disapproval at Sonya telling everything to the Nimkars in front of Aaisaheb.

videos.title: Episode 186
videos.overview: Isha’s parents try to cheer her up. Later, Isha speaks her heart out to Rupali, who suggests her to resort to her old remedy and asks her to go to the Ganesh Temple. While Isha goes to pray to god, Rupali calls Vikrant and informs that Isha is in the temple. Vikrant comes there, but to his surprise, Isha doesn’t talk to him. She taunts him for disappearing without informing her. Afterwards, Vikrant calls Mr Nimkar, but Isha refuses to talk to him. Vikrant informs Jhende that he had gone to Pune.

videos.title: Episode 187

videos.title: Vikrant feels suspicious about Jhende
videos.overview: Jalindar's photos with Isha as well as Jhende perplexes Vikrant. Isha and her mates put their plan into action. They finally manage to plant a seed of doubt in Vikrant's mind against Jhende. Jhende remembers a 'fakir's' forecast. Isha's parents get worried.

videos.title: Vikrant gets a good news
videos.overview: Vikrant tends to an ill Isha and takes her to a doctor. Meanwhile, Jhende threatens Manda to apprise him of all the developments at the Saranjame house. Later, she informs him that Isha is going to visit the temple with Aaisaheb. Vikrant gets a good news.

videos.title: Vikrant is stunned
videos.overview: Manda fails to stop Vikrant from going to the temple. Jhende, along with his goons, arrives at the temple, to hurt Isha. Isha is left speechless when Vikrant shares a piece of good news with her. Later, Vikrant is stunned by Isha's sudden disappearance.

videos.title: Vikrant saves Isha
videos.overview: Vikrant saves Isha from the goons and takes the bullet for her. During his treatment, the police visit his house for an enquiry. Sonya eavesdrops on Isha.

videos.title: Isha Collects Her Pregnancy Report
videos.overview: Isha wonders why Vikrant saved her. Pushpa thinks about Vikrant and Isha. Later, Isha visits the doctor to collect her pregnancy report.

videos.title: Jaydeep Confronts Jhende
videos.overview: Jaydeep reminds Jhende about the skeletons in his closet. Isha shares her internal dilemma with Rupali. Sonya once again confuses Isha’s parents.

videos.title: Pushpa Finds out about Isha's Pregnancy
videos.overview: Jaydeep and Sonya get into an argument. Pushpa is stunned about Isha's pregnancy. Rupali rebukes Ranjana for giving Isha's pregnancy report to Pushpa.

videos.title: Isha's Parents Refuse to Talk to Her
videos.overview: Rupali informs Isha that Pushpa knows about her pregnancy. Jhende has a plan to see Vikrant. At her maternal home, Isha's parents refuse to talk to her.

videos.title: Jhende's Goons Kidnap Vikrant
videos.overview: Nimkar asks Isha for proof. Pushpa tries to reason with her. Nimkar reminds Isha of something about Vikrant. Elsewhere, Jhende's goons kidnap an unconscious Vikrant.

videos.title: Isha Reveals the News to Jaydeep
videos.overview: Jaydeep and Aaisaheb suspect Jhende for the kidnapping. Isha is shocked to hear about Vikrant's kidnapping from his house. Later, she tells Jaydeep that she is pregnant.

videos.title: Isha and Jaydeep Seek Jalindar's Help
videos.overview: To expose Isha, Jhende decides to capture Jalindar. Meanwhile, Isha and Jaydeep decide to seek Jalindar's help. Jhende tries to present his side to Vikrant.

videos.title: Jalindar Promises to Find Vikrant
videos.overview: Jalindar promises Jaydeep that he will find Vikrant. Jhende learns about Isha and Jaydeep's meeting with Jalindar. Jhende finally concludes that Isha is indeed Rajnandini.

videos.title: Vikrant and Jalindar Come Face to Face
videos.overview: Jhende tries to win back Vikrant's trust. Isha, Jaydeep, and Mayra get worried when Jalindar goes to meet Jhende alone. Later, Vikrant and Jalindar come face to face.

videos.title: Vikrant Returns Home
videos.overview: Jalindar assures Vikrant about Isha's honesty. Vikrant returns home. On his return, Isha comes back home and enquires about Jalindar and Jhende.

videos.title: Vikrant Reveals Isha's Pregnancy
videos.overview: Vikrant shares the news of Isha's pregnancy with the family. Aaisaheb gets worried about avenging Rajnandini and Dadasaheb's death, but Isha tries to talk to her.

videos.title: Isha's Dilemma
videos.overview: Vikrant and Isha discuss baby names. The thoughts of Rajnandini's past and her own future mess with Isha's mind. Meanwhile, something bothers Jaydeep.

videos.title: Vikrant Stumbles upon a Clue
videos.overview: Vikrant stumbles upon Rajnandini's book and Dadasaheb's pen. Isha tries to find a way out of the situation by sharing her turmoil with her parents.

videos.title: Vikrant Gets Restless
videos.overview: Vikrant's suspicion of Isha makes him restless. Mayra conveys this information to Isha. Vikrant learns that Jhende's doubts regarding Isha were true.

videos.title: Vikrant's Attempt to Find the Truth
videos.overview: Vikrant pours his heart out to Rajnandini's photo. Isha feels that Vikrant suspects her. Later, Vikrant tries to extract the truth from Isha's father.

videos.title: Isha Makes a Plan
videos.overview: Isha fears getting exposed. She tries to find out the details about her father's conversation with Vikrant. Later, Isha decides to make Vikrant realise his mistakes.

videos.title: Aaisaheb is Doubtful of Isha's Plan
videos.overview: Nimkar tells Pushpa that he has revealed the truth to Vikrant. Aaisaheb is doubtful that Isha can extract a confession out of Vikrant. Sarjerao informs Vikrant that he has been called downstairs.

videos.title: Isha Exposes Vikrant
videos.overview: Isha exposes Vikrant. Vikrant believes that Isha is indeed Rajnandini. Sonya is shocked on learning the truth. Aaisaheb asks Isha to call the police.

videos.title: Tula Pahate Re
videos.overview: When Vikrant reveals his feelings for Isha, she remembers all the moments she had shared with him. Later, Vikrant's sudden decision shocks everyone.
